text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the town we visited, Bamboo Memory and 
I ended up watching a kendo tournament 
together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Listening to Bamboo Memory's passionate 
commentary as an experienced kendo 
practitioner... we watched the matches all 
the way through the finals.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"—Man, that was a brilliant torso strike! 
What an intense final match! Well, guess 
it's time to head—"
"H-Hold on a second! You over there...!"

*pant* *pant*... It really is you, 
Bamboo...! Do you remember me?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Aren't you the one who just won the 
tournament earlier!? Wait, you remember 
me—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah! Could it be?! You're from that 
dojo I used to go to...!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"—Man, what a surprise, though! Running 
into you in a place like this!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
If I recall, you suddenly moved away, 
didn't you? I was so shocked, you know!? 
'Cause you didn't say a single word to me 
about it!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Childhood Friend
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, sorry. Back then, Bamboo had just 
started racing and seemed super busy. 
Plus... I felt a bit guilty toward her.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Childhood Friend
text_block_list.text:
"...Because back then, I wasn't able to 
become the kind of presence Bamboo was 
looking for."

text_block_list.name: Young Bamboo
text_block_list.text:
—And get this! Dad made a promise with him 
that they'd meet again in next year's 
finals!

text_block_list.name: Young Bamboo
text_block_list.text:
That's so awesome~! I wanna have a fierce 
battle with a rival like that too!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Childhood Friend
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo was seriously strong, after all. 
Her drive to push forward was just 
mind-blowing! Neither I nor any of the 
other girls stood a chance.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Childhood Friend
text_block_list.text:
I can only say this now, but honestly, 
when Bamboo chose the path of racing, I 
couldn't help but wonder if it was because 
we were too weak.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: N-No... T-That's...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Childhood Friend
text_block_list.text:
"...I decided that I'm definitely going to 
get stronger! Strong enough to beat 
Bamboo! So... would you mind sparring with 
me for a bit?"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Of course! Challenge accepted!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: —Toaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without armor or padding, they pulled 
their blows... Yet despite that, the two 
exchanged strikes with breathtaking, 
overwhelming intensity!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—*pant*, *pant*... So strong! You've 
really gotten stronger, seriously...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Childhood Friend
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! Fufu. Though honestly, we've 
both grown together, right?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Childhood Friend
text_block_list.text:
I'm always watching your races, Bamboo. We 
might be walking different paths right 
now, but... let's both keep giving it our 
all!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...Osu!! On our respective paths, we'll 
fight fiery battles with our fiery 
rivals!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Then, after a firm handshake... Bamboo 
Memory's childhood friend walked away.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...Gaaah, so hype! It's so hype! A 
reunion! A rematch! Friendship! A promise! 
It's waaaay too hype~~~~!!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOO! I'm gonna channel this heat into 
both my legs and burn it off at full 
throttle~!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
*pant, gasp*! More, more...! Forward... 
forward--!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(This boiling, irresistible sensation... I 
know it. Somewhere in my past...!)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(Right. No matter how much I practiced, 
the fuzziness wouldn't go away... my chest 
was burning, unbearable! Before I knew it, 
I was running...!)

text_block_list.name: Young Bamboo
text_block_list.text:
"...Ghh, further... push forward, 
forward-!! Aaaaaaaaaaah--!!"

text_block_list.name: Young Bamboo
text_block_list.text:
*Haaah*, *pant*, *pant*... Ahhhhhh! I feel 
AMAZING...!

text_block_list.name: Young Bamboo
text_block_list.text:
(Run, huh... That's it... Races! In that 
world, even rivals could—!)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(And... I really did find them! The 
absolute best rivals! And—)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
“—Trainer! Listen to this! Going for that 
run made me remember something awesome!”

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I came from the world of kendo to racing 
just to find the ultimate rival! And right 
now, I'm making that dream come true!!
choice_data_list:
Then... let's make it come true by beating 
your rivals!

Let's keep going down this path without 
looking back.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Osu!! So that I can be proud of my dream 
in front of that friend earlier— no, in 
front of anyone on this Earth!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I'm gonna give it my all together 
with you~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory spoke with burning 
passion... It was a day that renewed my 
resolve to support her along her racing 
path.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Of course! If I hadn't come to this world, 
I never would've met Oguri-senpai, all my 
rivals, and—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"And I wouldn't have met you either, 
Trainer! All that's left is to keep 
running with fiery passion!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory spoke with burning 
passion... It was a day that renewed my 
resolve to support her along her racing 
path.
